content: Mu nanana Te Naa-tamme nanesootuhidu ka Stephen nabatsana tzakwuhooka. Unu oo yagakuse oo tugu. Ewa'yoo numu ka mu tunaka'oedyukudu unu toomoo'oo. Soo Saul besa soonamme ka oo nabatsase yise oona nonobe-too Te Pabe'e naka'oedyukudu wate mu manoyugwena mu tsapewo'ya ka mu wutumetakwuse. Ewow nanana wutumeta momoko'ne nokosoo. Soo Saul yise mu tunaka'oedyukudu ka Jerusalem mee naneadu-witoo wateka mu goekwuse. Mu Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe suu'mu oesoo nabenihoo. Mu ewa'yoo tunaka'oedyukudu nana'emota petukwuhoo. Ka Jerusalem-wi'yoona, ka Judea noko Samaria mee nananeadu-kooba'yoo mea'a. Mu numu ka oonow meana soo Jesus Te Pabe'e mee mu tuukwemena.
Soo Stephen pua'a, Philip mee naneadu oona Samaria mee naneadu teepu-wi petuga. Onow petugase ka mu oeteoo numu Te Pabe'e Jesus-witu tuukwe'e.

Ewow numu besa 'mayugwe. Ewa'yoo tsoapagoedu ka mu tsoapa umu-makoo tayakwunina. Umu tsoapa yise wa'ageyina meahooyakwe mu tsoapagoedu yise besa 'maneyakwe. Soo Philip yise mu numu ka Jesus-witu mu tuukwena, mu yise ka oo poonnena yise ka Philip besa nakabetse'a.
Mu numu yise besa sokwama.
Oona Samaria-wi sumu'yoo tupoohadu nana nobe-ga'yoo, Simon mee naneadu. “Nu besow pooha-ga'yoo,” mee mu nemooagana.
Mu numu yise oo naka'oedyukuna yise meeoo unakwe, “Oosoo tookwa Te Naa God.” Wuna'me yise 'manepetuga ka tu pooha-ma numahanena.
Meno'o soo Philip ka Te Naa 'manepunne-kwitu mu numu tuukwe'e soo Jesus yise togesapa Te Pabe'e. Mu nanana-no momoko'ne ka oo naka'oedyukuna, baa-wi namatzaka.
Soo Simon punno'o numu-no baa-wi namatzaka. Oosoo ka Philip nagennumme. Ka Philip pooha manakwe oo poonnena ka oo poohagana, Simon yise oo nasoodyagena.
Te Pabe'e tuukwewabe oo nakase, ka mu Samaria-witu numu Te Naa unnepu naka'oedyukuna, mu waahoo nanana Jerusalem-witu, Peter noko John umu-matoo taya.
Samaria-wi petuga, mooasoo ewa'yoo Te Pabe'e-wi tunaka'oedyukudu baa-wi namatzakapu. Gisoo ka Te Naa Besa Pooha wumadu.
Mu Peter-no John mu nanesootuhikuna umu-ma matuguna, umu yise ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-matu-ma nasootuhi.
Simon punno'o o, oosoo ka mu tuukwewabe poonne umu ka mu nananesootuhidu-ma tubetse matuguyina, Simon yise meeoo mu netamma,
“Yaa'a, nu sakwa ka poohabe-matu tumu. Nu punno'o mu-kwa'ne'yookwu. Nu punno'o umu-ma matuguyina, umu ka Te Naa Besa Pooha-matu-ma nasootuhidooa.”
Soo Peter meeoo oo netamma, “Soo Suta'yoo noko kadoo'oo u mayugwekwu. U ka Te Naa tamme sootuhipu too'e netumuna.
U tookwa gi numme-matu soo Te Naa u sopedakwatoo. U suta'yoo ka meeoo tusooyugwena.
Nu u sopedakwatoo u ooosapa suta'yoo. Soo hee ooosapa u-tamme gi toge'yookwu. Suda u tusooyugwena oo soomu'wuse, ka Te Naa-matoo nanesootuhi. Soo Te Naa ka suda u tusooyugwena gi sootu'adyidooa.”
Simon yise ka Peter meeoo netamma, “Ka Te Naa-matoo nuka nanesootuhiku. O'no saa'a soo hee nuka u tuukwepu gi oo-toogoo manedooa.”
Umu Peter-no John yise ka Te Naa unnena wahase, oona punowsoo kodyuka Jerusalem-witoo. Ka kodyuna, ka teepu mu Samaria-witu numu ka Te Naa unnena tuukwemena.

Soo sumu'yoo Te Naa tummatzidu toha kasa-ga'yoo ka Philip-baa petugase, meeoo oo netamma, “U sakwa mease, gi ka po kaaheno habedu-too meapana, ka taba meana-kwi sakwa u ka Jerusalem-wi'yoona, mea ka Gaza mee naneadu-kwi u petugakwu.”

Sumu'yoo nana wuguna-wi me'a. Mooasoo Jerusalem-wi nanesootuhitooase, punowsoo pummesoo teepu-koobatoo kodyuna, Ethiopia mee naneadu-kwitoo. Soo nana mu numu tumanagana mabetseadu, ka Ethiopia numu moohedu mogo'ne tummatzidu.
Paba tuneana kaduno'o, o'nosoo ka Te Naa yadooawabe, Isaiah mee naneadu tubona.
Soo Te Naa Besa Pooha ka Philip meeoo netamma, “Ka nana hatsukase, oo-nosoo meakwuni.”
Ka oo hatsukase, oo naka ka Isaiah tubo tuguna oo ne'a. Soo Philip yise oo tubenga, “U haa'a oo nakasopedakwadoo maka u tuneana?”
Oo nanekwegease mee'e, “Gi, nu gi oo nakasopedakwatoo. Haga sakwa mitu e tuukwe? Nu-baa katuno.”
Mee yise tuneakooha,

content.text: “Soo seepu puu gi tunema'yu ka pummetu sebakwuse, pummetu batsakwuse tuwow. Umu-wa'nesoo soo Te Pabe'e gi hayoo unakwe.
Umu ka Te Pabe'e-ma'yoo nanekoena, gi besa oo matuku. Mu numu suda manakwe ka Te Pabe'e batsase.”

content: Soo nana ka Philip meeoo tubenga, “Haga-witu netamma, puusoo haa'a pute haka?” “Jesus-witu,” mee'e soo Philip oo nanekwegea, “Soo Jesus tubetse Te Pabe'e.”
Soo Philip yise ka tu tuneana-witu oo tuukwese yise ka Te Pabe'e-witu tuwazoo oo tuukwe'e.
Ooosapa memeadape yise ka banunadu-kumaba pepetuga. Soo nana meeoo unakwe, “Yaa'a baa. U sakwa mi e matzaka.”
Ka waguna tutziwabe yooi tuunguse, ka baa-witoo Philip-no memea. Soo Philip yise ka baa-wi oo matzaka.
Ka baa-wi'yoona pakuase, soo Te Naa Besa Pooha ka Philip bihooka. Soo nana yise besa soonammena, tu nobe-kwitoo mea.
Azotus mee naneadu toogoo, soo Philip mease, yise kwenaha-tamme meadooa, Caesarea mee naneadu-wi petu. No'okosoo putoogoo tu meatoo, ka Te Pabe'e-witu mu numu tuukwemena.

footnotes.text: -28 Mu Ethiopia-witu numu ka mu numu moohedu momoko'ne Candace mee ne'a.
